nom: ROUND LAB Pine Calming Cica Ampoule

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report the serum calms breakouts and inflammation over a summer of use, feels lightweight and non-greasy, and one notes it works well specifically for oily skin though it can be drying on dry or mature skin.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin describe it as hydrating and firming, with one saying it never caused dryness even used only a few times a week, though the same product is described as potentially drying if applied to dry or mature skin by another reviewer.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin, some also acne-prone, report reduced redness, brighter-looking skin, and hydration, though one found the texture a bit heavy on combination/oily skin.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin repeatedly report reduced redness and irritation, soothing during retinol/tret use, and no stinging, with several calling it gentle enough for reactive or rosacea-prone skin; one sensitive-skin reviewer nonetheless reported irritation.
segments.mature: One reviewer in her early 50s in a dry climate reports the ampoule's hydration helps her rosacea-prone, mature skin, while another commenter warns the line can be drying if used on mature skin.

concerns.aging: One mature reviewer in her 50s reports improved hydration and reduced redness on rosacea-prone, mature skin; no other aging-specific outcomes (fine lines, firmness) are described in detail.
concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers report increased hydration, plumpness, and softness, some citing hyaluronic acid, with skin feeling moisturized rather than dry after use; no reviewer reports the product causing dehydration.
concerns.redness: The large majority of reviewers report visibly reduced redness, including rosacea and sunburn-related redness, often within days; two reviewers report the product made their skin red and irritated instead.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers with irritated or reactive skin (including retinol/tret users) report the serum soothes and calms without stinging or added irritation; one reviewer nonetheless reports the product itself triggered irritation.
concerns.spots: Some reviewers mention hyperpigmentation improving alongside redness reduction over time, but this is only noted incidentally by one or two reviewers, not a primary focus.
concerns.blemishes: Most acne-prone reviewers report fewer breakouts, calmer active acne, or full clearing after weeks of use, including hormonal, nodular, and cystic mentions; however, one reviewer describes the worst acne of her life after six weeks, and others report new breakouts or small white bumps despite continuing to like the product.
concerns.oiliness: Feedback on oil control is mixed and thin: one reviewer says it didn't noticeably reduce sebum, while another describes it as suited to oily skin without leaving residue.

extraits.texte: This product gave me the WORST acne of my life; even worse than my cystic hormonal acne. I switched over my skin care routine (slowly) to using Round Lab after seeing this advertised all over. At first I assumed my skin must be purging with how awful the acne was, but 6 weeks and two periods later my skin looks disgusting. All this did was keep me from wanting to go to social events or take pictures for 6+ weeks (not to mention I'm now spending hundreds to fix this). I do NOT recommend for any type of acne prone skin.

I've been using this ampoule for several months now as part of my serum routine. I couldn't love this ampoule more due to its silky, yet non-sticky texture. It smoothes over my skin effortlessly and helps to tone down the redness on my rosacea-prone cheeks. This is the perfect complement to your daily/nightly skin care routine, and if you've been on the fence about whether an ampoule is worth adding to your skincare repertoire, it's a no-brainer. I should also mention that I'm in my early 50s and live in a very dry mountain climate, so using products that hydrate is a must for me.

I received a sample size of this with a previous order. I struggle with combination skin and hormonal acne. I have been using this product for 6 weeks. I did have a slight purge for the first 5 weeks, but nothing worse than what I've experienced in the past. At week 6, my breakouts have finally calmed and my texture + redness is going away. I have not added anything else new to my routine, so I know that this specific product is what finally helped me after I felt like nothing would. It is slightly thick and sometimes dries tacky feeling, but I don't mind as this is part of my night routine. I use it 3x/week and it never causes any dryness, super hydrating actually! I love this product!

People don't talk enough about how this whole line contains LHA, a gentler derivative of salicylic acid. All the benefits of BHA for acne and deep pore cleaning without the associated dryness. Perfect for my sensitive, dry & acne-prone skin. Hydrating and calming too. Love this line and will keep this in my routine long term

The texture is thicker than I expected and feels a bit heavy on my combination/oily skin type. But it's very soothing and hydrating and very effective in calming blemishes (I personally like its sheet mask more). It's used up very quickly, and I wish there were different sizes.

very targeted treatment, worked wonderfully for soothing and eliminating the bacteria on my brother's inflamed skin from intense acne. Recommend only for oily skin, can be drying if used on dry or mature skin.

extraits.titre: Worked wonders in clearing up skin issues
extraits.texte: It cleared up both my rosacea and psoriasis. It helped to get rid of the redness and irritated look of my skin too,
